thread:
Michelle: Quick sync — Helix Labs security review scheduled for tomorrow morning. They asked for three things we need to deliver: RBAC change auditability for service accounts, KMS/HSM attestation + key provenance, and SIEM export (Splunk) with TLS verification. Can we produce an evidence bundle + runbook updates before the call?
Josh: I can pull an audit export and sample diffs. Do they want 90 days or 12 months? Helix legal asked for 90 days first-party evidence.
Michelle: 90 days is fine for initial packet. They also specifically want 'who/what/why' for RBAC changes (i.e., user, action, justification field).
sec-bot: Automated snapshot created for tenant=helix-labs: evidence_snapshot_1743216789.tgz (mock). Attached manifest: /evidence/helix/manifest-1743216789.json
Samir: For KMS: Hosted => we can provide envelope logs + KMS audit entries (cloud-KMS). Private => HSM attestation and key export proofs. Need to confirm FIPS/HSM cert copy is allowed to share.
Elaine: I'll own the runbook and the evidence bundle. Josh — can you paste the export CLI and a tiny sample log so I can validate the parser?
Josh: CLI I used locally: 
```
redwoodctl audit export --tenant helix-labs --from 2026-03-01 --to 2026-06-01 --filter "rbac,keys" --format json --output helix_rbac_keys_202603-202606.json
```
Josh: sample log line (redacted):
```
{"ts":"2026-06-01T14:12:03Z","actor":"svc-account-helix-deploy","action":"grant-role","role":"model-reader","before":"none","after":"role:model-reader","request_id":"req_9ab3","reason":"onboard service for inference"}
```
Michelle: Perfect. Make sure the export includes a `justification`/`reason` field. Helix will correlate that with their change ticket IDs.
Samir: On key provenance: we can include key-creation events, wrapping key IDs, and HSM attestation documents. For private deployments we have to coordinate with ops to run `hsm-attest` and capture the signed attestation blob. Ops: ping @eng-oncall to schedule.
Elaine: For SIEM: Helix wants Splunk HEC + TLS pin. We have an example config in docs but they want a concrete fingerprint we'd use for their environment. Josh — can you export a small sample that demonstrates the TLS fingerprint and event format?
Josh: Example Splunk HEC snippet (redacted):
```
# outputs.conf snippet
[httpout:helix_splunk]
server = splunk-01.helix.svc:8088
sslCA = /etc/ssl/certs/ca.pem
sslVerifyServerCert = true
hec_token = REDACTED
```
Josh: Sample event shape: `event.source=redwood.audit`, `event.type=rbac_change`, `event.request_id=...`
Michelle: Also raising another item — vulnerability triage. There's an advisory for fastloader (CVE-2026-1234) used in model-serving images. Helix asked whether that affects dedicated/private images and what remediation steps we have.
Samir: Short answer: CVE-2026-1234 affects fastloader < 1.2.3. Hosted: we rolled patches in the last maintenance window and applied a runtime mitigation (sandboxing). Dedicated/private: customers must update instance images or apply the patch; we can provide a patched image and an upgrade playbook. I'll run a canary patch in staging tomorrow.
Elaine: Need wording for the call: "We have mitigations in hosted, and we provide patched images + step-by-step upgrade playbook for Dedicated/Private. We can also provide a timeline and evidence of patching for customer environments."
Josh: I'll attach the canary results and CVE triage note to the evidence bundle. Also will redact any internal IPs.
sec-bot: Evidence bundle prepared: /evidence/helix/evidence_bundle_1743216789.tgz (contents: audit_export.json, splunk_snippet.txt, hsm_attestation.pdf (placeholder), cve-triage.md)
Michelle: Great. Final items before call: 1) Elaine — runbook + bundle (ETA 4h) 2) Josh — audit export + Splunk fingerprint (ETA 2h) 3) Samir — HSM attestation template + CVE triage note (ETA 6h) 4) I'll prepare slide with 'what we can/cannot share' checklist.
Samir: Noted. I'll also add a short note about retention policy: audit events stored 365 days for enterprise tenants, archived beyond that on request.
Elaine: Copy. I'll stub the slide deck and drop a link in this thread.
Michelle: Thanks team — look for a quick dry-run 30m before the customer call. :thumbsup:
